## POST `/api/2.58/directories`

**Tier:** T1+ (check: some POSTs are actions)  

The operation that creates a `managed directory` at the specified path. The `managed directory` name must consist of a `file system` name prefix and a `managed directory` name suffix, separated by a colon (:). The suffix must be between 1 and 63 characters (alphanumeric and '-') in length and must begin and end with a letter or number. Additionally, the suffix must include at least one letter or '-'. Users must either set `names` to create a `managed directory` with a specified full name, or set `file_system_names` or `file_system_ids` in the query parameters along with `suffix` in the body…

## DELETE `/api/2.58/directories`

**Tier:** T3  

Deletes one or more managed directories. To be deleted, a managed directory must be empty and not attached to any enabled export policies. Deleted managed directories cannot be recovered. The `ids` or `names` parameter is required, but cannot be set together.

## POST `/api/2.58/directories/locks/nlm-reclamations`

**Tier:** T1+ (check: some POSTs are actions)  

Creates an NLM reclamation, which is a system-wide operation that affects all clients, so only one may be in progress at a time. Attempting to initiate reclamation while one is in progress will result in an error. When NLM reclamation is initiated, all NLM locks are deleted and client applications are notified that they can reacquire their locks within a grace period.
